## Review checklist
- [ ] Checked current main and existing PRs for duplicate or superseded work.
- [ ] Preserved unrelated edits, provenance and frozen artifacts.
- [ ] No credentials, private account records or unintended generated files.
- [ ] Data/source limits and remaining risks are stated.
- [ ] Independent review requested or review limitation explained.
- [ ] No unrequested merge, deployment, live provider action or production migration.
